# Tycho repository instructions

Before work, read `AGENTS.md` and `governance/INDEPENDENCE.md`. They apply to all outputs and tool use. Tycho is independent and self-contained. References to employer-specific documents, sources, code, internal technology use, architectural decisions, and component names are strictly prohibited, including paraphrases, anonymization, indirect derivation, and generated metadata. Employer names and abbreviations are prohibited everywhere, including governance and scanner configuration.

Use independent public primary sources and original synthetic examples. Write in English. Follow `authoring/METHODOLOGY.md` and `authoring/STATE.md`. Run the boundary check and review evidence and source origin before committing. Never treat passing automation as semantic or provenance certification.
